name_reason: Already compliant with the data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: data_fd2_battle_ prefix (battle-core read-only table), 'tile_attr' domain, 'mv_modifier' descriptor, 'table' reflects the int[6] array data type. No Ghidra address residue. The trailing '6' is absent (the dimension is encoded only in the C declarator [6], which is correct). 'mv' (movement/AP) is accurate: the disassembled access applies the entry as a signed percent to a unit's wAP (and movement cost), distinct from the sibling DEF table at 0x51A2A.
purpose: Per-tile-attribute movement/AP percent modifier table, indexed by the terrain tile-attribute id (0..5); each entry is a signed percentage added to a unit's AP (and movement cost) when it stands on that terrain.
logic_summary: Read-only int[6] = {5,0,-5,-5,-5,0}. Accessed as dword ptr [idx*4 + 0x51A12] where idx is the tile-attribute byte returned by fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos; the value is signed-IMUL'd by AP, then signed-IDIV'd by 100 (SAR EDX,0x1F sign-extend before IDIV), so negative entries (-5 = 0xFFFFFFFB) act as a -5% penalty: effective_AP = AP + (modifier*AP)/100. Bounded at exactly 6 elements by the immediately-following sibling DEF table at 0x51A2A.
element_semantics: Signed 32-bit percent modifier per terrain tile-attribute id (index 0..5). Values {+5%, 0, -5%, -5%, -5%, 0} applied to AP and movement cost.
comment_original_issue: The two-line preamble immediately above the declaration said 'Non-const: read-only in-game (no writers), but mutated by test fixtures; the Watcom extern in globals.h must agree (const/non-const mismatch is E1129)' -- stale and self-contradictory: the declaration directly below is 'const int32', the extern in globals.h:558 is also 'const int32', and a full xref scan over the 24-byte range shows ANY_WRITE=false (all 5 xrefs are DATA reads). Per the const-data rule, zero game-side writes => truly read-only => const; the 'Non-const' note misrepresented the final state.
notes: Verified via disassembly of fd2_execute_attack_damage_calculation @ 0x1eda7 (MOV EDX,[EAX*4+0x51A12]; IMUL EDX,[AP]; SAR EDX,0x1F; IDIV 0x64) and decompile of all 4 readers (fd2_execute_attack_damage_calculation, fd2_ai_score_physical_attack [2 xrefs], fd2_calculate_combat_hit_outcome, fd2_render_terrain_info_hud_panel). globals.h:558 extern is const int32[6] and agrees with the definition; no E1129 risk. Ghidra data plate was null/empty so a concise plate was created (data plate via run_script_inline + cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...)). Main src comment block (purpose/logic/raw bytes) was already accurate and was kept; only the contradictory 'Non-const' 2-line preamble was removed. Ghidra program saved.
